cases.authoring: Hand-built XOIR graph entering the real pipeline at the packaging/contract stage. It measures contracts, workflow composition/audit, the runtime bridge and the executor - NOT source extraction (suite description). The graph itself is the ground truth.

world.justification: No fact expectations. The graph holds 3 concepts and 4 decision nodes but the case does not measure semantic extraction, so they are not asserted. (The suite description says 'closed world everywhere'; that is true of capabilities and workflows only.)
The graph has exactly eight capability nodes and all eight are expected.
The four expected workflows are the complete set the graph's edges define.
